rows.title: Compare Unity 6 native, Unity web and Godot/web delivery

rows.title: Build signed portrait hello world on a real iPhone or Android

rows.acceptance: Cold start, touch, safe area, background and resume tested; no claim of success without actual device

rows.acceptance: Fresh checkout imports with specified editor and no third-party paid files

rows.title: Add CI build smoke and EditMode test skeleton

rows.acceptance: Reported exact supported tests; failure on compile errors; no fake device automation

rows.title: Prototype portrait drag versus thumbstick controls

rows.acceptance: One-tap or one-stick onboarding; mirrored layout; no stale touch after pause

rows.title: Audit starter assets and source licenses

rows.acceptance: CC0/free candidates recorded; paid assets not committed or purchased

rows.title: Hold G0 architecture and distribution approval gate

rows.title: Implement chase camera with occlusion and recovery

rows.title: Decide G1 fun go/no-go and design revision
